title: About the club
intro: Bringing the power of the ocean to Salinas youth since 2017.
body:
Salinas Surf Club started in 2017, when Jeff Smallwood, a teacher in East Salinas, and a friend who was a state lifeguard took four students surfing.

Many kids in Salinas do not have easy access to the beach, and we are here to change that. On Saturdays during the school year, a school bus brings students from fourth grade through high school to the beach in Monterey, where our volunteers are waiting with boards and wetsuits.

Our volunteers are first responders, lifeguards, healthcare workers, and community surfers, and they train with California State Parks lifeguards. Students learn water safety and surf at their own pace.

We have since expanded to hiking and whale watching, and we are planning overnight camping trips. Everything is provided at zero cost to families.
